pilot.note: 3 smoke queries (not the fresh set), median s of 3: qwen1.5b 33.0, qwen3b 59.6, llama3.2:3b 70.3, gemma3:4b 72.1. Rule: run only models with pilot median <= 60 s, so llama3.2:3b and gemma3:4b are not run (speed). All four returned parseable JSON.

rule.eligible: median latency over all queries < 30.0 s AND answered rate on answerable >= 0.6 AND wrong-answer rate on no_answer <= 0.2
rule.grade: faithfulness is graded only for eligible models, every sentence of every answered response
rule.choose: among qualified: highest answered rate on answerable, then higher supported rate, then lower median latency. If none qualifies the extractive default stays.
rule.second_pass: random 20 percent of graded sentences (seed 42) graded again, agreement reported
